race.comment: ILLEGAL JUSTICE (2) returns in outstanding form after a determined Rockhampton victory a fortnight ago where he drew clear to score comfortably by over a length. He cops an extra 3.5kg in a similar field, but we think he can cope, so go again. EXODAS (1) boasts a flawless record here, winning all six appearances on this circuit, and with the advantage of the pole position, he can remain unbeaten here. BE BOB ALOOLA (4) was not that far away last start at Rockhampton and he could improve again at value, while TORANAGA (5) has the ability to make his presence felt if he can find the form that has seen him win 3 of his last 5 starts. Don't drop him in this.
